questions.stem: Why does soap not work well in hard water?

options.text: Hard water has too high a pH for soap
Soap is destroyed by chlorine in hard water
Hard water is too cold for soap to dissolve
Soap reacts with calcium and magnesium ions to form insoluble scum

questions.explanation: Hard water contains dissolved calcium (Ca2+) and magnesium (Mg2+) ions. Soap (sodium stearate) reacts with these ions to form insoluble calcium or magnesium stearate, which appears as grey scum. More soap is wasted before it can lather and clean effectively.
